en.s: The Battle of Poitiers was a major battle of the Hundred Years' War between England and France. The battle occurred on 19 September 1356 near Poitiers, France. Preceded by the Battle of Crécy in 1346, and followed by the Battle of Agincourt in 1415, it was the second of the three great English victories of the war.

zh.s: 普瓦捷战役是英法百年战争期间的一场重要战役，于1356年9月19日在法国普瓦捷附近爆发。英格兰在1346年克雷西战役和1415年阿金库尔战役中也曾获胜，普瓦捷战役是这三场著名胜仗中的第二场。

en.s: The siege of Marienburg was an unsuccessful two-month siege of the castle in Marienburg (Malbork), the capital of the monastic state of the Teutonic Knights. The joint Polish and Lithuanian forces, under command of King Władysław II Jagiełło and Grand Duke Vytautas, besieged the castle between 26 July and 19 September 1410 in a bid for complete conquest of Prussia after the great victory in the Battle of Grunwald (Tannenberg).

zh.s: 马林堡围城战是一次历时两个月、以失败告终的围城行动，目标是条顿骑士团修道会国首都马林堡（今马尔堡）的城堡。1410年7月26日至9月19日，波兰和立陶宛联军在波兰国王瓦迪斯瓦夫二世·雅盖沃和立陶宛大公维陶塔斯指挥下围攻城堡，试图在格伦瓦尔德（坦能堡）战役大胜后彻底征服普鲁士。

en.s: The Battle of Leobersdorf was a battle fought near Leobersdorf on September 19, 1532, as part of the Habsburg-Ottoman War (1526–1552).

zh.s: 莱奥伯斯多夫战役于1532年9月19日在莱奥伯斯多夫附近爆发，属于哈布斯堡-奥斯曼战争（1526—1552年）的一部分。

en.s: The 1547 Battle of Odaihara was one of a series of battles waged by Takeda Shingen in his long campaign to conquer Shinano province. In this particular encounter he was fighting the forces of Uesugi Norimasa, who was based in Echigo province but had decided to intervene in Shinano to prevent Shingen from overrunning the whole province. The Uesugi army attempted to relieve the castle of Shika, which Shingen had besieged, but were attacked and defeated at Odaihara on 19 September 1547.

zh.s: 1547年的大井原之战是武田信玄长期征服信浓国的一系列战事之一。这次交战中，信玄的对手是上杉宪政所率部队；上杉宪政以越后国为据点，为阻止信玄占领整个信浓国而出兵干预。上杉军试图解围信玄此前围攻的志贺城，却在1547年9月19日于小田原遭到攻击并被击败。

en.s: The sieges of Haddington were a series of sieges staged at the Royal Burgh of Haddington, East Lothian, Scotland, as part of the War of the Rough Wooing, one of the last Anglo-Scottish Wars. Following Regent Arran's defeat at the battle of Pinkie Cleugh on Saturday 10 September 1547, he captured the town of Haddington. The intention was to form a network of mutually supporting English forts in lowland Scotland.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 粗暴求爱战争期间，苏格兰东洛锡安皇家自治市哈丁顿发生了一系列围城战；粗暴求爱战争是英苏战争的最后几场战争之一。1547年9月10日（星期六），摄政王阿兰在平基克莱战役中战败后，攻占了哈丁顿。英军的意图是在苏格兰低地建立一套彼此支援的堡垒网络。

en.s: The siege of Mons of 1572 took place at Mons, capital of the County of Hainaut, Spanish Netherlands (present-day Belgium), between 23 June and 19 September 1572, as part of the Eighty Years' War and the French Wars of Religion. In the spring of 1572, after the capture of Valenciennes by a Protestant force under Louis of Nassau, the Dutch commander continued with his offensive and took Mons by surprise on 24 May.

zh.s: 1572年的蒙斯围城战发生在1572年6月23日至9月19日，地点是埃诺伯国首府蒙斯（当时属西属尼德兰，今比利时），是八十年战争和法国宗教战争的一部分。1572年春，一支由路易·德·拿骚率领的新教军队攻占瓦朗谢讷后，荷兰指挥官继续进攻，并于5月24日出其不意地攻占蒙斯。

en.s: The Battle of Brest (1596) (Croatian: Bitka kod Bresta) was fought on September 19, 1596 between the Ottoman forces of Achmed Hafis Pasha, Beylerbey of Vidin, and the Germanic and Croatian forces led by Ivan Drašković, Ban of Croatia. The battle was a part of the Croatian–Ottoman wars and Ottoman–Habsburg wars between the Ottoman Empire and the Habsburg monarchy.

zh.s: 布列斯特战役于1596年9月19日爆发，交战双方是艾哈迈德·哈菲斯帕夏指挥的奥斯曼军队与伊万·德拉什科维奇指挥的日耳曼和克罗地亚军队；德拉什科维奇当时担任克罗地亚总督。波兰史家也称此战为“布列斯特附近的捷列斯波尔战役”。该战役属于克罗地亚-奥斯曼战争以及奥斯曼-哈布斯堡战争的一部分。

en.s: The siege of Heidelberg or the Imperial-Spanish capture of Heildelberg took place from 23 July to 19 September 1622, at Heidelberg, Electorate of the Palatinate, between the Imperial-Spanish army led by Johan Tzerclaes, Count of Tilly and Don Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba against the Anglo-Protestant forces of Frederick V, Elector Palatine, commanded by Sir Gerard Herbert and Sir Horace Vere during the Palatinate campaign, in the context of the Thirty Years' War.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 海德堡围城战，又称帝国—西班牙军队攻占海德堡，发生于1622年7月23日至9月19日，地点在普法尔茨选侯国的海德堡。这场战斗是三十年战争期间普法尔茨战役的一部分，交战双方是蒂利伯爵约翰·采尔克拉埃斯和唐·贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德科尔多瓦率领的帝国—西班牙联军，以及普法尔茨选侯腓特烈五世的英格兰—新教军队；后者由杰拉德·赫伯特爵士和霍勒斯·维尔爵士指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Tangier in 1675 was an engagement between the Moroccans and the English garrison of Tangier, who raided the vicinity for cattle. The English raid ended in a fiasco.

zh.s: 1675年的丹吉尔战役是摩洛哥军队与驻守丹吉尔的英军之间的一次交战。当时，英军出城到附近地区抢夺牲畜，这次突袭最终以惨败告终。

en.s: Bacon's Rebellion was an armed rebellion by Virginia settlers and their indentured servants and slaves, that took place from 1676 to 1677. It was led by Nathaniel Bacon against Colonial Governor William Berkeley, after Berkeley refused Bacon's request to drive American Indians out of Virginia. Thousands of Virginians from all classes (including those in indentured servitude and slavery) and races rose up in arms against Berkeley, chasing him out from Jamestown and ultimately torching the settlement.
en.n: Jamestown is burned to the ground by the forces of Nathaniel Bacon during Bacon's Rebellion.

zh.s: 培根起义是弗吉尼亚殖民者及其契约劳工和奴隶于1676年至1677年发动的一场武装叛乱。起义由纳撒尼尔·培根领导，反抗殖民地总督威廉·伯克利；此前伯克利拒绝了培根驱逐弗吉尼亚原住民的要求。来自各阶层和不同族群的数千名弗吉尼亚人，包括契约劳工和奴隶，拿起武器反抗伯克利，将他赶出詹姆斯敦，最终把这座城镇付之一炬。
zh.n: 纳撒尼尔·培根的部队在培根起义期间将詹姆斯敦付之一炬。

en.s: The 1710 Battle of Rio de Janeiro was a failed raid by a French privateering fleet on the Portuguese colonial city of Rio de Janeiro in August 1710, during the War of the Spanish Succession. The raid was a complete failure; its commander, Jean-François Duclerc, and more than 600 men were captured. French anger over the Portuguese failure to properly hold, release, or exchange the prisoners contributed to a second, successful raid, the following year.

zh.s: 1710年里约热内卢战役是西班牙王位继承战争期间，法国私掠舰队于1710年8月突袭葡萄牙殖民城市里约热内卢但以失败告终的战役。法军指挥官让-弗朗索瓦·迪克莱尔及600多名士兵被俘。葡萄牙未能妥善看管、释放或交换俘虏，引发法方不满，促成次年第二次成功突袭。

en.s: The siege of Novi was a military engagement during the Austro-Turkish War (1716–1718). The Austrians besieged Novi Grad held by the Ottomans. The siege ended in fiasco for the Austrians, who suffered heavy losses.

zh.s: 诺维围城战是奥土战争（1716—1718年）期间的一场军事交战。奥地利军队围攻由奥斯曼帝国控制的诺维格勒。围城以奥军惨败告终，奥军损失惨重。

en.s: The Battle of Guastalla or Battle of Luzzara was a battle fought on 19 September 1734, between Franco-Sardinian and Austrian (Habsburg) troops as part of the War of Polish Succession.

zh.s: 瓜斯塔拉战役也称卢扎拉战役，于1734年9月19日爆发。波兰王位继承战争期间，法-撒丁联军与奥地利（哈布斯堡）军队在此交战。

en.s: The Battle of the Coweecho River (also known as Black Hole) took place in what today is Macon County, North Carolina between Patriot militia and their Catawba allies and Cherokee warriors with their Loyalist allies on September 19, 1776, during the American Revolutionary War. The region of the Appalachian mountain range and nearby areas became the scene of a dispute between the Cherokee and Anglo-European settlers who were continuing to expand west.

zh.s: 美国独立战争期间，1776年9月19日，爱国者民兵及其卡托巴族盟友与切罗基战士及其保王党盟友在今天北卡罗来纳州梅肯县境内交战。该地区位于阿巴拉契亚山脉及其附近，切罗基人和向西扩张的英裔欧洲移民在此发生冲突。

en.s: The Battles of Saratoga were fought September 19 and October 7, 1777 over the same ground by the American Continental Army and the British Army near Saratoga, New York during the American Revolutionary War. The second battle ended with a decisive American victory, and the surrender of the British army there. The outcome greatly affected the course of the war, persuading France to enter the war as an American ally.

zh.s: 萨拉托加战役由两场战斗组成，分别于1777年9月19日和10月7日在同一片战场上进行，交战双方是美国独立战争期间的大陆军和英军，地点在纽约州萨拉托加附近。第二场战斗以大陆军决定性胜利告终，英军在当地投降。这一结果深刻影响了战争进程，促使法国作为美国盟友参战。

en.s: The siege of Khotyn took place in Khotyn, modern-day Ukraine, in 2 July–19 September 1788, and was part of the Austro-Turkish War and the Russo-Turkish War. The Habsburg Austrian army of 18,000 men led by Prince Josias of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld marched from Bukovina to lay siege to Khotyn. It was joined by an Imperial Russian army commanded by Ivan Saltykov.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 霍京围城战于1788年7月2日至9月19日在霍京发生（今属乌克兰），是奥土战争和俄土战争的一部分。由萨克森-科堡-萨尔费尔德的约西亚斯亲王率领的1.8万名哈布斯堡奥军从布科维纳进军，开始围攻霍京。随后，伊万·萨尔特科夫指挥的俄罗斯帝国军队也加入围城。

en.s: The battle of Torfou-Tiffauges was a battle on 19 September 1793 during the War in the Vendée. It pitted many Royalist military leaders against Republican troops under Jean-Baptiste Kléber and Canclaux.

zh.s: 托尔富-蒂福日战役于1793年9月19日在旺代战争期间爆发。多名保王派军事领袖率军对阵让-巴蒂斯特·克莱贝尔和康克洛指挥的共和派军队。

en.s: The Battle of Brest (referred to by Polish historians as "Bitwa pod Terespolem" (Battle near Terespol)) was a battle between Russian imperial forces and Polish rebels south-west of Brest (near the village of Terespol), present-day Belarus, on 19 September 1794. It was part of the Kościuszko Uprising.

zh.s: 布列斯特战役是俄罗斯帝国军队与波兰起义军之间的一场战斗。波兰史家称之为“捷列斯波尔战役”。1794年9月19日，双方在布列斯特西南方交战，地点靠近捷列斯波尔村，现属白俄罗斯。该战役是科希丘什科起义的一部分。

en.s: Sometimes called the Battle of Limburg or Second Battle of Altenkirchen or Battle of the Lahn (16–19 September 1796), this was actually a single-day battle followed by a lengthy rear-guard action. The action occurred during the War of the First Coalition, part of a wider conflict known as the French Revolutionary Wars. Limburg an der Lahn is located in the state of Hesse in Germany about 31 miles (50 km) east of Koblenz.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 这场战斗有时被称为林堡战役、第二次阿尔滕基兴战役或拉恩河战役，发生于1796年9月16日至19日。它实际上是一场单日战斗，之后又进行了漫长的后卫行动。战斗发生在第一次反法同盟战争期间，这场更大规模的冲突也称法国大革命战争。林堡安德尔拉恩位于德国黑森州，科布伦茨以东约31英里（50公里）。

en.s: The Battle of Bergen was fought on 19 September 1799 and resulted in a Franco-Batavian victory, as Generals Guillaume Brune and Herman Willem Daendels (Brune commanded both his own French and Daendels' Batavians) defeated the Anglo-Russian forces that had landed in North Holland under the Duke of York as supreme commander and Lieutenant General Ivan Hermann.

zh.s: 1799年9月19日，法国-巴达维亚联军在卑尔根战役中获胜。纪尧姆·布律纳将军和赫尔曼·威廉·丹德尔斯将军击败了在北荷兰登陆的英俄联军；布律纳同时指挥法国军队和丹德尔斯的巴达维亚军队。英俄联军由约克公爵担任最高指挥官，伊万·赫尔曼中将也参与指挥。

en.s: The first siege of Callao was a prolonged military blockade of the Real Felipe Fortress (as well as other fortresses) in Callao by the Liberating Expedition of Peru under the command of General José de San Martín in July 1821 which culminated in the capitulation of Marshal José de La Mar in September of the same year, with him switching sides from the Royalist side to the Patriot side.

zh.s: 1821年7月，何塞·德·圣马丁将军指挥的秘鲁解放远征军对卡亚俄的皇家腓力城堡及其他堡垒实施长期军事封锁。围城于同年9月以元帅何塞·德·拉马尔投降告终；他也从保王派转投爱国派。

en.s: The Battle of Azenha Bridge (Portuguese: Combate da Ponte da Azenha) was the first battle of the Ragamuffin War, which took place on the night of the 19th to the 20th of September 1835. It gave way to the capture of Porto Alegre by the rebels on the following day.

zh.s: 阿泽尼亚桥战役（葡萄牙语：Combate da Ponte da Azenha）是拉加穆芬战争中的第一场战斗，发生于1835年9月19日至20日夜间。次日，叛军由此攻占了阿雷格里港。

en.s: The Battle of Carpintería was an important battle between troops loyal to the government of Manuel Oribe and the revolutionary forces led by Fructuoso Rivera. The combattants differentiated themselves with white or red-colored insignias. The whites were conservative and supporters of Federalism, while the red-colored supported liberalism and were close to the Unitarians. The battle meant a success for the government.

zh.s: 卡平特里亚战役是曼努埃尔·奥里韦政府军与弗鲁克图奥索·里维拉领导的革命军之间的一场重要战斗。双方以白色或红色徽记区分：白色一方持保守立场、支持联邦主义；红色一方支持自由主义，并与统一派关系密切。战斗以政府军获胜告终。

en.s: The Battle of Aranzueque was a military confrontation at the village of Aranzueque, Spain, on 19 September 1837, during the First Carlist War. The battle pitted the troops of the pretender to the Spanish crown, Carlos V, against the troops of the Queen Regent Maria Christina, led by the general Baldomero Espartero. The loyalist troops had attacked the Carlists at Alcalá de Henares and pushed them through Alcarria towards Aranzueque.

zh.s: 第一次卡洛斯战争期间，1837年9月19日，双方在西班牙阿兰苏埃克村交战。西班牙王位觊觎者卡洛斯五世一方与摄政女王玛丽亚·克里斯蒂娜一方交战，后者由巴尔多梅罗·埃斯帕特罗将军率领。此前，女王派军队在阿尔卡拉德埃纳雷斯袭击卡洛斯派军队，并将其一路赶过阿尔卡里亚，逼近阿兰苏埃克。

en.s: The Battle of Famaillá (Famaillá, Tucumán Province, Argentina, September 19, 1841), was a Federal Party victory, under the command of former Uruguayan president Manuel Oribe, over the army of the Unitarian Party under general Juan Lavalle, during the Argentine Civil War.

zh.s: 法马伊亚战役发生于1841年9月19日，地点在阿根廷图库曼省法马伊亚。联邦党在前乌拉圭总统曼努埃尔·奥里韦指挥下击败了由胡安·拉瓦列将军率领的统一党军队，这是阿根廷内战期间的一场战役。

en.s: The Slovak Volunteer Campaigns, Slovak uprising of 1848–1849, Slovak Revolt or the Slovak Revolution occurred in Western parts of Upper Hungary (today mostly Western Slovakia) with the aim of equalizing Slovaks, democratizing political life and achieving social justice within the 1848–49 revolutions in the Habsburg Monarchy. It lasted from September 1848 to November 1849.

zh.s: 斯洛伐克志愿军起义又称1848—1849年斯洛伐克起义、斯洛伐克叛乱或斯洛伐克革命，于1848年至1849年发生在上匈牙利西部（今大多属于斯洛伐克西部）。起义旨在争取斯洛伐克人的平等、推动政治生活民主化，并在哈布斯堡君主国1848—1849年革命期间实现社会公正。起义从1848年9月持续到1849年11月。

en.s: Annibale de Gasparis (Italian pronunciation: [anˈniːbale de ˈɡasparis]; 9 November 1819 – 21 March 1892) was an Italian astronomer, known for discovering asteroids and his contributions to theoretical astronomy.

zh.s: 安尼巴莱·德·加斯帕里斯（1819年11月9日—1892年3月21日）是意大利天文学家，以发现小行星和对理论天文学的贡献闻名。

en.s: The Battle of Barbourville was one of the early engagements of the American Civil War. en.s: The Third Battle of Winchester (or Battle of Opequon), was fought in Winchester, Virginia, on September 19, 1864, during the Valley Campaigns of 1864 in the American Civil War. As Confederate Lt. Gen. Jubal A. Early raided the B&O Railroad at Martinsburg, WV, Union Maj. Gen. Philip H. Sheridan advanced toward Winchester along the Berryville Pike with the VI Corps and XIX Corps, crossing Opequon Creek. The Union advance was delayed long enough for Early to concentrate his forces to meet the main assault, which continued for several hours. Casualties were very heavy. The Confederate line was gradually driven back toward the town.

en.s: The Siege of Paris took place from 19 September 1870 to 28 January 1871 and ended in the capture of the city by forces of the various states of the North German Confederation, led by the Kingdom of Prussia. en.s: The Continuation War, also known as the Second Soviet–Finnish War, was a conflict fought by Finland and Nazi Germany against the Soviet Union during World War II. It began with a Finnish declaration of war on 25 June 1941 and ended on 19 September 1944 with the Moscow Armistice. The Soviet Union and Finland had previously fought the Winter War from 1939 to 1940, which ended with the Soviet failure to conquer Finland and the Moscow Peace Treaty.

en.s: General elections were held in Sweden on 19 September 1948. Despite a campaign by a large part of the Swedish press against socializing insurances, controlled foreign trade and rationing regulations still in use since the war, freshman Prime Minister and Social Democratic leader Tage Erlander managed to defeat the People's Party-led opposition under Bertil Ohlin by a higher election turnout. He maintained his government with only minor losses and the Swedish Social Democratic Party remained the largest party, winning 112 of the 230 seats in the Second Chamber of the Riksdag.

zh.s: 瑞典于1948年9月19日举行大选。战后仍在实行保险社会化、对外贸易管制和配给制度，瑞典媒体中有不少声音反对这些政策。尽管如此，新任首相兼社会民主党领袖塔格·埃兰德仍击败了由人民党领袖贝蒂尔·奥林领导的反对派，投票率也有所上升。社民党仅小幅失去席位，继续执政，并在议会第二院230个席位中赢得112席，仍是第一大党。

en.s: The Battle of Masan was an engagement between United Nations (UN) and North Korean (NK) forces, which took place early in the Korean War between August 5 and September 19, 1950, in the vicinity of Masan and the Naktong River in South Korea. It was part of the Battle of Pusan Perimeter, and was one of several large engagements fought simultaneously. The battle ended in a victory for the UN after large numbers of United States (US) and Republic of Korea (ROK) troops were able to repel the repeated attacks of two North Korean divisions.

en.s: General elections were held in Sweden on 19 September 1976. Although the Swedish Social Democratic Party remained the largest party, winning 152 of the 349 seats in the Riksdag, a coalition government was formed with the Centre Party, the People's Party and the conservative Moderate Party, which formed Sweden's first non-socialist government since 1936. Centre Party leader Thorbjörn Fälldin, who had widely been expected to take over the government in the previous election of 1973 (which turned out to bring a 175-175 draw between the left and right blocs), was appointed Prime Minister, the first not from the Swedish Social Democratic Party since Axel Pehrsson-Bramstorp's brief interregnum 40 years earlier.

zh.s: 瑞典于1976年9月19日举行大选。瑞典社会民主党仍是第一大党，在349个议会席位中赢得152席，但中央党、人民党和保守派温和联合党组成联合政府，结束了自1936年以来的首个非社会主义政府空档。中央党领袖图尔比约恩·费尔丁出任首相。此前，人们普遍认为他会在1973年大选后接任，但当时左右两大阵营各得175席，形成平局。费尔丁是自40年前阿克塞尔·佩尔松-布拉姆斯托普短暂执政以来，首位非社民党籍首相。

The crash is the deadliest aviation accident in Turkey's history. The aircraft arrived in Istanbul from Milan, Italy, and took off again at 22:45 local time.

en.s: Elections were held in the state of New South Wales, Australia, on Saturday 19 September 1981. The result was a second "Wranslide": a landslide victory for the Australian Labor Party under Neville Wran, in which the government increased its already sizeable majority. The Liberals suffered the double indignity of losing the seat contested by their leader Bruce McDonald to an independent, and of being reduced to the same number of seats in parliament as their ostensible junior coalition partner, the National Country Party. In fact it was the second election in a row in which the sitting Liberal leader had failed to win a seat; Peter Coleman had been rolled in his own seat in 1978.

zh.s: 澳大利亚新南威尔士州于1981年9月19日星期六举行选举。澳大利亚工党在内维尔·沃兰领导下再次大胜，形成第二次“沃兰大胜”，执政党进一步扩大原本已相当可观的多数席位。自由党领袖布鲁斯·麦克唐纳在所竞选的选区败给独立候选人，自由党席位数也降至与名义上的小党联盟伙伴国家乡村党相同。其实，这已是连续第二次有在任自由党领袖未能赢得议席：彼得·科尔曼在1978年也输掉了自己所在的选区。

en.s: General elections were held in Sweden on 19 September 1982. They saw the return of the Swedish Social Democratic Party to power after six years in opposition, the longest period in opposition by the Social Democrats since the 1910s. The center-right coalition of Thorbjörn Fälldin had earlier suffered a loss upon the breakup of the government in 1981, the year before the election, when the rightist Moderate Party chose to withdraw from the government, protesting against the centrist tax policies of the Fälldin government. After regaining power, socialist leader Olof Palme succeeded in being elected Prime Minister again, having earlier held power between 1969 and 1976.

zh.s: 瑞典于1982年9月19日举行大选。社会民主党结束了六年的在野期后重新执政，这是该党自1910年代以来最长的一段在野时期。费尔丁领导的中右翼联合政府在1981年因温和联合党退出而受挫；该党反对费尔丁政府的中间派税收政策。社民党重新执政后，领袖奥洛夫·帕尔梅再次当选首相；他此前曾于1969年至1976年担任首相。

en.t: Saint Kitts and Nevis gains its independence
en.s: Saint Kitts and Nevis (SKN), officially the Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis, is an island country located in the Caribbean consisting of the two islands of Saint Kitts and Nevis, in the Leeward Islands chain of the Lesser Antilles. With 261 square kilometres (101 sq mi) of territory, and roughly 48,000 inhabitants, it is the smallest sovereign state in the Western Hemisphere, in both area and population, as well as the world's smallest sovereign Federation.

en.s: Mexico City is the capital and largest city of Mexico, as well as the most populous city in North America. It is one of the world's leading cultural and financial centers and, according to the Globalization and World Cities Research Network's 2024 ranking, is classified as an Alpha world city. Located in the Valley of Mexico on the high Mexican Central Plateau, the city sits at an altitude of 2,240 meters (7,350 feet).

en.s: The 1985 Mexico City earthquake struck in the early morning of 19 September at 07:17:50 (CST) with a moment magnitude of 8.0 and a maximal Mercalli intensity of IX (Violent). The event caused serious damage to the Greater Mexico City area and the deaths of at least 5,000 people. The sequence of events included a foreshock of magnitude 5.2 that occurred the prior May, the main shock on 19 September, and two large aftershocks.

en.t: Ötzi the Iceman is discovered in the Alps on the border between Italy and Austria
en.s: Ötzi (German: [œtsi]; c. 3275 BC – c. 3230 BC, also called The Iceman, Similaun man, or Tyrolean Iceman, is the natural mummy of a man who lived during the 4th millennium BC. Ötzi's remains were discovered on 19 September 1991 in the Ötztal Alps (hence the nickname "Ötzi") at the Austria–Italy border. He is Europe's oldest known natural human mummy, showing an unprecedented view of Chalcolithic (Copper Age) Europeans.

zh.s: 奥茨（德语发音：[œtsi]），又称“冰人”“西米劳恩人”或“蒂罗尔冰人”，是一具自然形成的木乃伊，属于公元前四千纪的人物，生活年代约为公元前3275年至前3230年。1991年9月19日，人们在厄茨塔尔阿尔卑斯山发现了他的遗骸，地点位于奥地利与意大利边境，因此得名“奥茨”。他是欧洲已知年代最早的天然人体木乃伊，为了解铜石并用时代的欧洲人提供了前所未有的资料。

en.s: The 2002 Ivorian coup attempt was a failed coup d'état in the Ivory Coast against Laurent Gbagbo's government by dissident factions within the Ivorian military that plunged the country into a multiyear-long civil war which tore it into two: the rebel-held North and the government-controlled South. Motives for the coup attempt include frustrations regarding the demobilizing of soldiers instated during General Robert Guei's rule and known for their loyalty towards him.

en.s: The 2006 Thai coup d'état took place on Tuesday 19 September 2006, when the Royal Thai Army staged a coup d'état against the elected caretaker government of Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra. The coup d'état, which was Thailand's first non-constitutional change of government in fifteen years, followed a year-long political crisis involving Thaksin, his allies, and political opponents and occurred less than a month before nationwide House elections were scheduled to be held. It has been widely reported in Thailand and elsewhere that General Prem Tinsulanonda, Chairman of the Privy Council, was the mastermind of the coup.

zh.s: 2006年9月19日星期二，泰国皇家陆军发动政变，推翻总理他信·西那瓦领导的民选看守政府。这是泰国15年来首次通过违宪手段更迭政府。此前，他信、其盟友和政敌之间的政治危机已持续一年；政变发生时，距离全国下议院选举原定举行还不到一个月。泰国及其他地区的媒体普遍报道称，枢密院主席、将军普雷姆·廷素拉暖是政变幕后策划者。

en.s: The 2008 South Carolina Learjet 60 crash occurred just before midnight on September 19, 2008, when a Learjet 60 (registration N999LJ) crashed while taking off from Columbia Metropolitan Airport in South Carolina. The weather at the time was cool, dry, and clear. The plane hit runway lights and crashed through the boundary fence, crossing South Carolina Highway 302 (SC 302/Edmund Highway/Airport Boulevard), and coming to rest on an embankment by the side of the highway. No one on the ground was hurt, but four of the six people on the plane (including both pilots) died in the crash, while the other two, Travis Barker and Adam Goldstein, suffered severe burns.

zh.s: 2008年9月19日午夜前不久，一架注册编号为N999LJ的Learjet 60公务机从南卡罗来纳州哥伦比亚大都会机场起飞时坠毁。事发时天气凉爽、干燥、晴朗。飞机撞上跑道灯和机场边界围栏，越过南卡罗来纳州302号公路（又称埃德蒙公路或机场大道），最后停在公路旁的坡地上。地面无人受伤；机上6人中有4人遇难，包括两名飞行员。其余两人特拉维斯·巴克和亚当·戈德斯坦严重烧伤。

en.s: A by-election was held in the provincial riding of Bay of Quinte on September 19, 2024, to elect a new member of the Legislative Assembly of Ontario following the resignation of Progressive Conservative MPP and cabinet minister Todd Smith for a new job in the private sector. It resulted in the victory of PC candidate Tyler Allsopp, though by a reduced margin compared to his predecessor.

zh.s: 2024年9月19日，安大略省昆特湾选区举行补选，选出新的省议会议员。此前，进步保守党省议员兼内阁部长托德·史密斯辞职，转到私营部门任职。补选由进步保守党候选人泰勒·奥尔索普获胜，但他的胜选差距小于前任。

en.s: The CMLL 92nd Anniversary Show (Spanish: 92. Aniversario de CMLL) was the 92nd annual (and 103rd overall) CMLL Anniversary Show professional wrestling pay-per-view and livestreaming event produced by Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL). It was held on September 19, 2025, at Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico. It was the first CMLL event to be livestreamed on TrillerTV and the first to be streamed with English commentary.

zh.s: CMLL成立92周年纪念赛是世界摔角理事会（CMLL）主办的职业摔角付费观看及直播赛事，于2025年9月19日在墨西哥墨西哥城的墨西哥竞技场举行。这是第92届年度周年纪念赛，也是按总场次计算的第103届。该赛事是CMLL首场通过TrillerTV直播、并首度提供英语解说的赛事。

en.s: The 2025 Bangladesh Challenge Cup was the second edition of the Bangladesh Challenge Cup. It is an annual football match contested by the champions of the previous season's Bangladesh Football League and Federation Cup competitions. Mohammedan SC crowned the champions of 2024–25 Bangladesh Premier League for the first time ever. Bashundhara Kings qualified as 2024–25 Fed Cup winners. Bashundhara Kings is the current edition champions of the cup who beat Mohammedan SC by 4–1 goals on 19 September 2025.

zh.s: 2025年孟加拉国挑战杯是该项赛事的第二届。比赛每年举行一场，由上赛季孟加拉国足球联赛和足协杯的冠军队伍争夺。穆罕默丹俱乐部首次夺得2024—25赛季孟加拉国超级联赛冠军；巴顺达拉国王队则以2024—25赛季足协杯冠军身份获得参赛资格。2025年9月19日，巴顺达拉国王队以4比1击败穆罕默丹俱乐部，夺得本届杯赛冠军。
